high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from medium.com, displaying an article about Large Language Models (LLMs) and their advancements in artificial intelligence. The time at the top of the screen shows 8:35, and the status bar indicates that the device is connected to LTE with a partially charged battery. The content of the article discusses how LLMs have revolutionized AI by processing input and generating output at the token level, which contrasts with human cognitive abilities that operate at multiple levels of abstraction beyond single words.
